verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents first-party connections to card and spend platforms like Brex and Ramp, which produce categorized transactions. It also documents reconciling bank and credit-card accounts, so connected financial accounts feeding transactions are implied. Nothing explicitly describes general bank-feed connections or an automatic daily import schedule. Missing for 10: explicit bank-feed connection docs (e.g., aggregator or supported-bank list), documented automatic daily or recurring sync cadence, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day
